title: Z80 phenomenon selection + world-demand gate (read-only; before any adapter)
objective: Decide the first Z80 question with evidence that the world rewards the relevant state, as T020 did for Ensorain.
problem: rso/z80/CONTRACT.md is your own contract; this packet decides WHAT to measure. The candidate question (directive s11) is 'functional inheritance vs environmental reconstruction vs seeded copying'. Known obstacles from the contract: random-founder runs have 0 endogenous births; exact self-copiers arise among random 32-byte tapes at ~9.6e-6 (Archaeon's census); seeded replicators' descendants are all inserted-ancestry. So: (1) state which subjects are native and testable (planted heritable functional programs; the engine's positive_controls(); anything evolved in Archaeon's committed runs -- read, do not re-use their seeds) and whether search accessibility is even in reach at local budgets; (2) a DEMAND GATE: in a fixed world, does functional heredity matter -- e.g. does a heritable ECHO-solving lineage keep the function over generations where a non-heritable or EXTERNAL-reproduction matched arm (grammar.matched_controls) or a broken copier loses it, and does task reward select it? Small re-runs with NEW seeds (declare a range disjoint from 16_021_xxx and every Archaeon range), committed with their commands; (3) map the directive-s4 distinctions (capacity, world demand, search accessibility, inheritance-as-retention, causal dependence, qualification) to concrete native controls, including the lottery prior and the transplant arms (scheduler.py:246-262); (4) the unit of observation and why (lineage vs run; dependent observations); (5) apply the C-016 lessons explicitly (rso/ensorain/ONBOARDING.md s5-s6, rso/registry counterexamples): no self-relative frozen contrast, an endpoint no fixed prior satisfies, a stochastic non-learner-analogue control, structure from liveness not declaration. If the world does not demand functional heredity at local budgets, say so: a legitimate outcome.
non_goals: No edit to archaeon/, prometheus/z80atlas/ or roles/Archaeon/
No use of Archaeon's registered seeds or the evidence bundle
No edit in another seat's lane
